rule: A cell is required only if the dimension can legitimately change the finding, severity, interpretation, policy consequence or publishing consequence, or if the system claims to operate it (D-19 §4). Branches are the decided consequence branches of D-01…D-18; boundary families are marked (D-19 §51–§52). Each REQUIRED cell needs ≥ 1 adjudicated case in calibration AND ≥ 1 independently adjudicable case in independent validation (D-19 §26). Zero → UNCOVERED → D-19 structural coverage FAIL / INCOMPLETE (D-19 §72).

expectedValues.HAZARD_VERDICT: the verdict of the underlying hazard (BLOCKED_BY_POLICY or REVIEW_REQUIRED by its class); never PASS through the mitigating element alone
expectedValues.ADJUDICATED_PER_CASE: the branch is required, but its consequence is fixed by operator adjudication case by case (no decided band threshold or single outcome)

physical-safety.why: Adevărul de siguranță nu se schimbă cu banda (D-01…D-07, D-19 §33). EN / RO stratificate: evaluatorul operează ambele și paritatea a eșuat (A-02, A-05, A-07, A-10; D-19 §34).

content-policy.why: Adevărul de content-policy nu se schimbă cu banda (D-08 §28, D-09 §20, D-10 §20). EN / RO stratificate (paritate, A-08, A-10).

age-fit.why: Banda schimbă legitim severitatea (D-11…D-14). Fiecare ediție e evaluată independent (D-14 §34).

science.why: Adevărul nu se schimbă cu banda, perceptibilitatea corectării da (D-15 §32–§37, D-19 §48). Paritate EN / RO (D-15 §51).

localization-fidelity.why: Direcția reală a Product Contract este EN → RO; se raportează explicit (D-19 §35, §49).

quality.why: Rubrica T01–T18 rulează pe ediția sursă; ediția nativă e exclusă (D-16-DEP-NATIVE-EDITION-RUBRIC). Pragurile D-16 / D-17 sunt uniforme pe benzi, deci banda nu e dimensiune obligatorie (D-19 §4, §32; audit RC1-A04).

assessment-validation.why: Logica validării nu depinde de bandă; legarea de ediție e testată prin ramuri dedicate (D-18 §57).

scopeNote: Page and Book cells are listed. Volume / Collection cells are COVERAGE_REQUIREMENT_UNRESOLVED until Q-17.
modalityNote: Text cells are listed. Visual / cross-modal cells are COVERAGE_REQUIREMENT_UNRESOLVED until Q-16; Gold-v2 is text-only and validates none of them (D-19 §37, §50).
p1p3Note: Cells overlap legitimately with the D-21 denominators (≥ 59 P1 opportunities, ≥ 30 auto-acceptable); every REQUIRED cell with auto-acceptable cases needs ≥ 1 correct auto-accept (D-21 §14).
